title: An attacker must control pagination data returned by an upstream API or service queried by an… (CVE-2026-115899)
description: CVE-2026-115899 is a critical vulnerability involving a REST Collector that uses response-based pagination. An attacker who can control the pagination data returned by an upstream API or service queried by the Collector can exploit this flaw. Successful exploitation allows execution of code with the permissions of the Worker service account.
